sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to Focus on the Arts.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听《聚焦艺术》。

sentences.en: I'm your host - Dave Green - and this - is your very own local radio programme.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人戴夫·格林，这是您专属的本地广播节目。

sentences.en: Every Friday evening we put the spotlight on different arts and culture facilities, and look at the shows and events that are on offer in the coming week.
sentences.zh: 每周五晚上，我们都会 spotlight 不同的艺术与文化场所，并介绍接下来一周内即将上演的各类演出和活动。

sentences.en: And today the focus is on The National Arts Centre.
sentences.zh: 而今天，我们的焦点是国家艺术中心。

sentences.en: Now, if you don't already know it yourself, I'm sure you've all heard of it.
sentences.zh: 如果您自己尚未去过，我相信大家一定都听说过它。

sentences.en: It's famous throughout the world as one of the major venues for classical music.
sentences.zh: 它举世闻名，是古典音乐最重要的演出场馆之一。

sentences.en: But did you know that it is actually much more than just a place to hear concerts?
sentences.zh: 但您是否知道，它实际上远不止是一个听音乐会的地方？

sentences.en: The Centre itself is a huge complex that a caters for a great range of arts.
sentences.zh: 该中心本身是一座庞大的综合建筑群，涵盖极为广泛的艺术门类。

sentences.en: Under a single roof it houses concert rooms, theatres, cinemas, art galleries and a wonderful public library, as well as service facilities including three restaurants and a bookshop.
sentences.zh: 在同一个屋檐下，它容纳了音乐厅、剧院、电影院、美术馆以及一座极佳的公共图书馆，此外还配有包括三家餐厅和一家书店在内的各类服务设施。

sentences.en: So at any one time, the choice of entertainment there is simply enormous.
sentences.zh: 因此，在任何时刻，那里可供选择的娱乐项目都极其丰富。

sentences.en: So. how did they manage to build such a big arts complex right in the heart of the city?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们是如何在城市正中心建成如此宏大的艺术综合体的呢？

sentences.en: Well, the area was completely destroyed by bombs during the war in 1940.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这一区域在1940年战争期间遭到了炸弹的彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: So the opportunity was taken to create a cultural centre that would be, what they called: 'the City's gift to the Nation'.
sentences.zh: 于是，人们借此机会打造一座文化中心，正如他们所称：‘城市献给国家的礼物’。

sentences.en: Of course it took a while for such a big project to get started, but it was planned in the 60s, built in the 70s and eventually opened to the public in 1983.
sentences.zh: 当然，如此大型的项目启动耗时颇久，但它于20世纪60年代规划，70年代建成，并最终于1983年向公众开放。

sentences.en: Ever since & 14 it then it has proved to be a great success.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，它一直取得了巨大成功。

sentences.en: It is not privately owned, like many arts centres, but is still in public hands - it's run by the City Council.
sentences.zh: 它不像许多艺术中心那样属于私人所有，而是由公众持有——由市议会负责运营。

sentences.en: Both our National Symphony Orchestra and National Theatre Company were involved in the planning of the project, and they are now based there - giving regular performances every week - and as the Centre is open 363 days of the year, there are plenty of performances to choose from.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家交响乐团和国家剧院公司均参与了该项目的规划工作，如今它们也常驻于此，每周定期演出；由于该中心全年363天开放，可供选择的演出数量十分可观。

sentences.en: So, to give you some idea of what's on, and to help you choose from the many possibilities, we've made a selection of the star attractions.
sentences.zh: 因此，为帮助您了解有哪些精彩活动，并从众多选项中做出选择，我们精选了几项明星亮点。

sentences.en: If you're interested in classical music, then we recommend you go along to the National on either Monday or Tuesday evening at 7.30 for a spectacular production of 'The Magic Flute' - probably the most popular of all Mozart's operas.
sentences.zh: 如果您对古典音乐感兴趣，我们推荐您于周一或周二晚7:30前往国家艺术中心，欣赏歌剧《魔笛》的精彩制作——这很可能是莫扎特所有歌剧中最为流行的一部。

sentences.en: It's in the Garden Hall and tickets start at only £8.00, but you'll have to be early if you want to get them that cheap!
sentences.zh: 演出地点为花园厅，门票起价仅为8英镑，但若您想以这个低价购票，就得尽早行动！

sentences.en: And remember, it's only on for those two evenings.
sentences.zh: 请记住，该剧仅在这两个晚上上演。

sentences.en: For those more interested in the cinema, you might like to see the new Canadian film which is showing on Wednesday evening at 8pm in Cinema 2.
sentences.zh: 如果您更钟情于电影，或许会喜欢周三晚8点在2号放映厅上映的加拿大新片。

sentences.en: And that's called 'Three Lives.' It's had fantastic reviews and tickets cost just £4.50, which is a reduction on the usual price of £5.50.
sentences.zh: 片名为《三生》，口碑极佳，票价仅为4.5英镑，比通常的5.5英镑优惠不少。

sentences.en: So, it's really good value, especially for such a great movie.
sentences.zh: 因此，观影性价比极高，尤其对于这样一部优秀影片而言。

sentences.en: But you can see the centre's main attraction at the weekend, because on Saturday and Sunday, 11 am to 10 pm, they're showing a wonderful new exhibition that hasn't been seen anywhere else in Europe yet.
sentences.zh: 不过，您可在周末欣赏到该中心的主打亮点：周六和周日（上午11点至晚上10点），将展出一场尚在欧洲其他地区未曾亮相的全新展览。

sentences.en: It's a collection of Chinese Art called 'Faces of China' - that's www.TopSage.com Test 37 7. 3408 in Gallery - and it has some really fascinating paintings and sculptures by tnstopSage.com from all over China - and the good news is that it is completely free, so don't miss it!
sentences.zh: 这是一场名为《中国面孔》的中国艺术展——网址为www.TopSage.com，测试37卷，第7页，第3408号，位于美术馆内——展出了来自全中国的诸多引人入胜的绘画与雕塑作品；好消息是，观展完全免费，切勿错过！

sentences.en: So why not go along to the National Arts Centre next week for one or all - of these great events - and you can always pick up a programme and check out all the other performances and exhibitions on offer, or coming soon, on almost every day of the year.
sentences.zh: 那么，何不下周就前往国家艺术中心，亲身体验其中一项或全部这些精彩活动呢？您还可以随时领取一份节目单，查阅几乎全年每天都有提供的其他演出与展览信息，或了解即将推出的各项活动。

sentences.en: Next week we'll be looking at the new Museum of Science . . .
sentences.zh: 下周我们将关注全新的科学博物馆……
